# External issues

  * [ffmpeg can't seek in Youtube's iOS m3u8 streams / `--download-sections` only downloads audio #9552](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/9552)
    * Use `-S proto:https` or `--extractor-args "youtube:player_client=default,-ios"`
  * [`--cookies-from-browser` "Permission denied" errors when Chrome/chromium-based browser is open in Windows #7271](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7271)
    * Try after closing chrome completely OR
    * Launch chrome from command line w/ `chrome.exe --disable-features=LockProfileCookieDatabase`
    * Alternatively, you can [install](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#installing-plugins) the [ChomeCookieUnlock yt-dlp plugin](https://github.com/seproDev/yt-dlp-ChromeCookieUnlock)
  * [`--cookies-from-browser`: WARNING: failed to decrypt with DPAPI / ERROR: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'decode' #10927](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10927)
  * [[youtube] Is downloading a livestream in 1440p or 2160p no longer available? #11262](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11262)
  * [[Youtube] 8k VR180 SBS videos no longer available #9903](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/9903)
    * Use `--extractor-arg "youtube:player_client=android_vr,default"`
  * [[Youtube] throttling and inconsistent speed in Russia #10443](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10443)
    * [Workarounds](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10443#issuecomment-2248940967)
  * [[Discord bot] Music stops in the middle #8854](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8854)
  * [[youtube] Endless "Incomplete data received" when downloading playlist #10394](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10394)
    * Don't use `--extractor-retries infinite`
  * [FFMPEG "Invalid data found when processing input" on live/post-live/dash videos (duplicate ftyp) #8641](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8641)
    * Regression in ffmpeg 6.1. Upgrade to ffmpeg 6.1.1 or to [master build](https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds/releases) revision `N-112916` or later
  * [[youtube] "Invalid data found when processing input" / ffmpeg errors on HDR VP9 in mp4 #7541](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7541)
    * ffmpeg bug. Upgrade to ffmpeg 7.0.1 or to the latest [master build](https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds/releases)
  * [`--mark-watched` fails with urlopen error #8149](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8149)
    * Disable pi-hole or whitelist `s.youtube.com`
  * [Chapter Embedding Results in Unnamed Chapters When Using Recent FFmpeg Builds #6859](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/6859)
    * ffmpeg regression. Use <https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds> or upgrade to 6.1.1 or newer
  * [yt-dlp is detected as a virus #25](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/25)
    * It's a false positive. Complain to your vendor. There is nothing we can do
  * [Incomplete Data Recieved #1787](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1787)
    * Broken from Youtube's side. If downloading comments, use `-i` to ignore the error
  * [Wrong year in metadata in M4A, MP4, FLAC format #3087](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3087)
    * Workaround: `--parse-metadata "%(release_year,upload_date).4s:(?P<meta_date>.+)"`
  * [pyinstaller temp files are not cleaned up when using yt-dlp.exe with mpv #10294](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10294)
  * [Long Start-Up Time for `yt-dlp_macos` #10425](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10425)
  * [`--download-sections` / ffmpeg fails to seek in a 26+ hour long Twitch m3u8 #5372](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5372)
  * [Using proxy and `--download-sections`/ ffmpeg fails with HTTP Error 400/401/403 #12915](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12915)



# FAQ

See <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ>

  * **[How to avoid Youtube's new "Super Resolution" AI-upscaled formats #15325](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15325)**
  * **[Getting deno to work in Termux. #15095 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15095#issuecomment-3544324838)**
    * Run a full Termux upgrade with `pkg update && pkg upgrade` before `pkg install deno`
  * **[[YouTube] Enhanced bitrate no longer available to download? #14133 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14133#issuecomment-3217679575)**
  * [**Filename too long**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1136#issuecomment-932077195)
    * Use `-o "%(title).150B [%(id)s].%(ext)s"`
  * **[[YouTube]`--write-comments`: "Incomplete data received. Giving up after 3 retries" warnings #15435](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15435)**
  * **[twitter: No video could be found in this tweet #14742](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14742)**
  * [[Question] odd ba* format selection? #979 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/979#issuecomment-919629354)
    * Generally do not use `ba*`
  * [Fix playlist_index's inconsistent behavior #302](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/302)
    * Check `playlist_autonumber` and `--compat-option playlist-index`
  * [yt-dlp python module not compiling with pyinstaller #3845](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3845)
    * Use `bundle/pyinstaller.py`
  * [Subtitle file is not deleted after being embedded #630 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/630#issuecomment-893659460)
    * Use `--compat-option no-keep-subs`
  * [`--download-sections`/`--sponsorblock-remove` does not cut at exact point #4216](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4216) / [YouTube Clip Downloads have unintented extra beginning part with no video #5080](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5080)
    * Use `--force-keyframes-at-cuts`
  * [Duplicating pull request from youtube-dl to yt-dlp #4202](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4202)
  * [How to check in browser if the video is DRM protected](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4062#issuecomment-1153474056)
  * [\--cookies-from-browser for a chrome/firefox like browser or non-default install location #2903](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/2903)
  * [What are yt-dlp's error codes? #4262 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4262#issuecomment-1173133105)
  * [Extractor option `language` for `crunchyrollbeta` #4640](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4640)
  * [Ability to strip Emoji from downloaded file  #4836](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4836) / [File names use "full-width" special characters: '？' vs '?' #5014](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5014)
  * [[Youtube] Extract exact timestamps #1803](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1803)
  * [[Feature Request] Crop to square thumbnail when embedding in MP3s #429 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/429#issuecomment-2282554440)
  * Download only videos with subtitles 
    * `--parse-metadata "%(subtitles.\:.0.ext|)s:^(?!\[\])(?P<has_subs>.)" -v --match-filter has_subs`
  * [How do I rename previously-downloaded files with nothing but the youtube video ID? #5692](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5692)
  * Remove specific fields from info-json - [[Suggestion] Redact `formats` in info json with an option #455 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/455#issuecomment-1367741786)
  * About subtitles in mp4 container - [Convert webvtt subtitles in mp4 into useable format #5833 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5833#issuecomment-1358246240)
  * [Find the API option for a CLI argument #5859 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5859#issuecomment-1363938900)
    * Use <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/devscripts/cli_to_api.py>
  * [[YouTube] `youtube:skip=translated_subs` doesn't work for some videos. #3875](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3875)
  * [Youtube bestvideo and vp9 preference. #1232 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1232#issuecomment-939635345)
  * [repo: git log broken by SSH signature #7322](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7322)
  * [download comments into separate comments.json file #2372 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/2372#issuecomment-1506413976)
  * [How to force a conversion to a specific video codec? #7607 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7607#issuecomment-1636960750)
  * [How to download youtube videos in mp4 format? #8880](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8880)
  * [How do I properly pass my Soundcloud oauth token to yt-dlp? #12249 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12249#issuecomment-2628937389)
  * [[youtube] 256kbps music formats not being extracted #12455 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12455#issuecomment-2677077342)
  * [[PYI-12704:ERROR] Failed to extract Cryptodome\Cipher_ARC4.pyd: decompression resulted in return code -1! #16522](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16522)
    * You probably don't have enough free disk space on the drive where your temp dir is located

# [Announcement] Dropping support for Python 3.10 #16916

[Announcement] Dropping support for Python 3.10#16916

[#17160](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/17160)

Copy link

Labels

[discussion/announcement](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22discussion%2Fannouncement%22)

## Description

[](https://github.com/bashonly)

[bashonly](https://github.com/bashonly)

opened [on Jun 10, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16916#issue-4628013111)

Issue body actions

### [Python 3.10 will reach its end-of-life in October 2026](https://devguide.python.org/versions/).

### Continuing yt-dlp's alignment of Python version support with their official support lifetimes, yt-dlp will be dropping support for 3.10 shortly thereafter.

This alignment of support is done primarily for two reasons:

  1. yt-dlp's Python dependencies have followed (and most likely _will_ follow) a similar trajectory of Python version support; we don't want to get stuck supporting an older version of Python than `urllib3` does, for example.
  2. To provide a predictable timeline for the developers and users who utilize the yt-dlp Python package.



Reactions are currently unavailable

Python 3.10 will reach its end-of-life in October 2026, at which time [yt-dlp will be dropping support for Python 3.10](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16916). The Windows executables are currently bundled with Python 3.10, so this is something that needs to change.

We have decided to bump the Windows executables' Python minor version all the way up to 3.14.

Per our testing, Windows 8 only supports our executables up through Python 3.11 and Windows 8.1 only supports them up through Python 3.12. Therefore **the Windows executables bundled with Python 3.14 will only support _Windows 10 and newer_**.

So why can't we just bump the Windows executables to Python 3.11 or Python 3.12 in October?

First, some background: The lifetime of a minor version of Python consists of these 5 stages (in order): `feature`, `prerelease`, `bugfix`, `security`, and `end-of-life`. (The `feature` and `prerelease` stages are not relevant to this explanation.) At any given time, the two latest minor versions of Python are in the `bugfix` stage (e.g. 3.13 and 3.14 currently). During the `bugfix` stage, there are patch releases published (e.g. `3.14.5` is the latest release, and the next bugfix release will be `3.14.6`) that deliver bugfixes and security fixes. Likewise, at any given time, the three oldest non-EOL minor versions are in the `security` stage (e.g. 3.10, 3.11 and 3.12 currently). During the `security` stage, there are _only security fixes_ delivered in patch releases.

Here's the thing, though: official Windows Python installers are only distributed for `bugfix` releases (and **not** for `security` releases), and the official installer releases are the only versions available to us via [GitHub's Windows runners](https://github.com/actions/runner-images) (and [`actions/setup-python`](https://github.com/actions/setup-python)), which we use to build our Windows executables.

This means that if we were to continue shipping Windows executables bundled with Python 3.11 or Python 3.12 (i.e. versions past their `bugfix` stage), we would be shipping executables with unpatched security vulnerabilities. The Python and OpenSSL libraries included in those executables would be _years_ behind the latest security patches.

You might be wondering: "Isn't this already a problem with the Python 3.10 Windows executables?" Yes, it is, and it's a problem we want to solve. We want to ship executables _without any_ known security vulnerabilities. And that's why we'll be bumping our executables' minimum required version of Windows.

Users on Windows 8, Windows 8.1 and Windows Server 2012 will still be able to use a Python installation of yt-dlp (instead of our executable), provided they have a supported version of Python installed on their system.

Reactions are currently unavailable

[](https://github.com/divinitycove)

[divinitycove](https://github.com/divinitycove)

opened [on Jul 31, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17337#issue-5025675151)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I've read the [**NO AI / NO LLM POLICY**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#no-ai--no-llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Worldwide

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Hello, NZ on Screen recently overhauled their backend/CDN/site layout, so what was a generic "/title/" URL like <https://www.nzonscreen.com/title/making-of-sleeping-dogs-2004/> now redirects to <https://www.nzonscreen.com/videos/making-of-sleeping-dogs-2004/>.

This now makes yt-dlp return:  
`"ERROR: Unsupported URL: https://www.nzonscreen.com/videos/making-of-sleeping-dogs-2004/"`

I've only done a bit of looking around, but they have divvied it up into /videos/, /all-music-videos/, or /all-series/, etc, but there's probably a more efficient way to find out the sitemap.

There's also been an overhaul for some some movies and TV, now instead hosted in a separate player, which is seemingly for the files that were originally split up into playlists (the issue solved by [#14126](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/14126)). They're now in a separate /m/player/ URL, i.e. <https://www.nzonscreen.com/m/player/compass-first-five-years-of-television-clip-1/>.

I'm not a developer but to me it seems like the player itself hasn't changed too much, just the URLs, so hopefully the extractor still works and it's just a case of fixing the URLs.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

Option --stop-on-unavailable-fragments#17328

## Description

[](https://github.com/remi-garcia)

[remi-garcia](https://github.com/remi-garcia)

opened [on Jul 29, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17328#issue-5012468384)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I've read the [**NO AI / NO LLM POLICY**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#no-ai--no-llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

There exists a function `--abort-on-unavailable-fragments`. This stop everything altogether.

I would like to have a similar option `--stop-on-unavailable-fragments` that just stops the download at the first missing fragment but still perform the rename, the mp3 conversion or any other step that would have happened after the download. This way, the downloaded file will be there but just "truncated". Sometimes, it is enough to have the beginning of the file.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output

### Checklist

  * I've read the [**NO AI / NO LLM POLICY**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#no-ai--no-llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Bulgaria

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

_This seems to be issue with any audio song, not only this one, so maybe it is unimplemented audio extractor?_  
When attempting to download or list formats for "At The Speed Of Light" (<https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/467339>) audio from Newgrounds, it fails with "No video formats found!". I've tried using no cookie and with account cookies and the error persists with both (no account cookie seems 403 error on other video, but with account cookie, other video on newgrounds is fine, while this song has same issue as with no account cookie)  
The audio song has download button. However, what I find for song even without download button, clicking "play" bring up the direct song url in my networks tab, so if that is issue (for other song), it might easy code extractor to get URL of mp3 this way. (programmatically calling function which the Play button does to get URL, or related). And this doesn't seem require account, however Newgrounds has something DDoS protection similar to Cloudflare which could cause issue, but I am unsure.

_I have updated to nightly build as issue template asked me_

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Region

_No response_

### Description

Using yt-dlp to download a long ongoing youtube livestream ends up with it erroring out with a 403 error and failing to reload playlist after 6 hours. From the bits of logs I have (currently running again to save full logs but it will take a while since it needs 6 hours to error out) it seems the link/token? issued by youtube for the session is designed to expire after 6 hours and lead to the issue. I will attach new full logs when the dl fails again in ~6hours.

### DO NOT REMOVE OR SKIP THE ISSUE TEMPLATE

  * I understand that I will be **blocked** if I _intentionally_ remove or skip any mandatory* field



### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a new site support request
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766) and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [guidelines for opening an issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#opening-an-issue)
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required



### Region

_No response_

### Example URLs

<https://www.spooncast.net/jp/cast/5950201>

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

VoDs on spooncast.net cannot be downloaded as site is not yet supported. VoDs are purely audio with a thumbnail and are served as .m4a

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

我不知道这是新版本的问题还是bilibili那边的问题，我去年使用-F的时候，下载凡人修仙传，还能列出所有分辨率，但是我今天换了dlp新版本，-F就无法列出所有分辨率

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output
    
    
    .\yt-dlp -F "best" https://www.bilibili.com/bangumi/play/ep3854808?from_spmid=666.5.banner.0
    .\yt-dlp -f "worst" https://www.bilibili.com/bangumi/play/ep3854808?from_spmid=666.5.banner.0
    这两个都不行了

## Description

[](https://github.com/ustclan)

[ustclan](https://github.com/ustclan)

opened [on Feb 4, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15825#issue-3896346637)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Description:  
When downloading long Twitch VODs (2+ hours), the last 30 minutes of video gets compressed into just a few seconds, resulting in black screen for the remainder of the video. The issue is caused by the FFmpegFixupM3u8PP post-processor.

Reproduction Steps:

Download a long Twitch VOD (2+ hours):
    
    
    yt-dlp -f '480p' https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2670757337
    

Play the downloaded video

Observe that the final 30 minutes are either black screen or compressed into just a few seconds of playback

Affected URL:

<https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2670757337>

Root Cause:  
The issue occurs in the FFmpegFixupM3u8PP post-processor when it tries to fix MPEG-TS in MP4 container. The problematic code is in yt_dlp/postprocessor/ffmpeg.py:
    
    
    python
    def run(self, info):
        if all(self._needs_fixup(info)):
            args = ['-f', 'mp4']
            if self.get_audio_codec(info['filepath']) == 'aac':
                args.extend(['-bsf:a', 'aac_adtstoasc'])  # This causes issues
            self._fixup('Fixing MPEG-TS in MP4 container', info['filepath'], [
                *self.stream_copy_opts(), *args])
    

The -bsf:a aac_adtstoasc bitstream filter appears to cause timestamp corruption when processing long MPEG-TS streams, resulting in the final portion of the video being compressed/misaligned.

Expected Behavior:  
The entire video should be preserved with correct timing and duration.

Actual Behavior:  
The last portion (approximately 30 minutes) of long videos gets compressed into a few seconds, showing as black screen.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Ongoing membership live streams appear on the website under the `/live` tab, but do not appear when trying to download the tab with `yt-dlp`.

The stream _does_ appear when giving yt-dlp the `/membership` tab instead.

This is with my main Google/YouTube account, so I am not willing to share the account details in this case, sorry.

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a new site support request
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I am trying to download a video that was shared with me on SharePoint. Unfortunately, the downloaded video is not a video, but rather an HTML document "access denied"

I can give the URL, but unfortunately, it's a private video with a required login.

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

United States

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I found that one livestream download keeps unexpectedly ending despite the stream continuing. This has happened on two different live streams from on [this channel](https://www.youtube.com/@courtroom3386) today. When trying to resume, it indicates it was already downloaded, so I have to delete the prematurely completed file for yt-dlp to grab and download it again, only for it to prematurely end again while the live stream keeps broadcasting.

This is currently happening on this video: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=de3STw8r6mo>

I captured debug logs, which are copied below; the download had ended prematurely, and it's still streaming/live at the same URL as I write this.

I download many other live streams from other channels that don't experience this issue, but for some reason, multiple videos on this channel keep downloading early, requiring me to delete the downloaded incomplete file mp4 file and manually download again using the same command.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

# [feature request] including additional meta-data for subtitles. ffmpeg disposition. #17318

[feature request] including additional meta-data for subtitles. ffmpeg disposition.#17318

Copy link

Labels

[enhancementNew feature or request](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22enhancement%22)New feature or request[triageUntriaged issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22triage%22)Untriaged issue

## Description

[](https://github.com/eladkarako)

[eladkarako](https://github.com/eladkarako)

opened [on Jul 28, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17318#issue-4993737455)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I've read the [**NO AI / NO LLM POLICY**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#no-ai--no-llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

`yt-dlp` might be able to add some additional meta-data,  
to the embedded subtitle (..and other streams, but this issue is for subtitles..).

for example for SDH/closed captions/closed captioning/hearing impaired
    
    
    ffmpeg 
    -i "file:foo.mp4"
    -i "file:foo.en.srt"
    -i "file:foo.en.sdh.srt"
    -map 0:a:0 -map 0:v:0
    -map 1:s:0
    -map 2:s:0
    ...
    ...
    -metadata:s:s:0 language=eng
    -metadata:s:s:0 handler_name=English
    -metadata:s:s:0 title=English
    
    -metadata:s:s:1 language=eng
    -metadata:s:s:1 handler_name=English
    -metadata:s:s:1 title=English (SDH)
    //or, if there only one language, just   -metadata:s:s:1 title=SDH
    -disposition:s:1 hearing_impaired

* * *

the reason, that I am specifying SDH,  
is because it is slightly easier to distinguish those, by name, in some websites:

  * [How to embed subtitles using Python version of yt-dlp ? #6267](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/6267) (`...fr vtt, vtt de vtt, vtt de_sdh vtt`)
  * [Download subtitles with multiple formats in the same format #16475](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16475)
  * [Unable to download multiple subtitles of same language and same format #946](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/946)



* * *

`ffmpeg -dispositions` notes:

gives about ~27 types,  
few of those meant for subtitle streams, other might have an effect for specific role in specific media-players that would be able to handle the additional "meta-data"  
...arr ffmpeg's `AV_DISPOSITION_*` bit flags...
    
    
    default
    dub
    original
    comment
    lyrics
    karaoke
    forced
    hearing_impaired
    visual_impaired
    clean_effects
    attached_pic
    timed_thumbnails
    non_diegetic
    captions
    descriptions
    metadata
    dependent
    still_image
    multilayer
    

there is probably better documentation but in a nutshell..

  * `default`: Mark this stream as the default choice for its type (audio/subtitle/video) when the user/player hasn’t selected something explicitly.
  * `dub`: Audio track that is a dubbing of the original (as opposed to original-language audio).
  * `original`: The original (non-dubbed) version of the content (e.g., original language audio).
  * `comment`: A commentary track (e.g., director commentary / commentary audio).
  * `lyrics`: Subtitles intended to show song lyrics.
  * `karaoke`: Karaoke-style subtitles (timed to singing/words in a karaoke manner).
  * `forced`: Subtitles that are forced to display even if the user hasn’t enabled subtitles (commonly for untranslated dialogue).
  * `hearing_impaired`: Subtitle/closed-caption style intended for hearing impaired viewers (e.g., SDH: speaker labels, extra cues).
  * `visual_impaired`: Audio description (or subtitle style) intended for visually impaired viewers.
  * `clean_effects`: A “clean” version intended to omit/adapt certain non-dialog audio (typically removing profanity or specific audio effects, depending on release practices).
  * `attached_pic`: A stream that contains an attached picture (album art / cover image) rather than normal timed media.
  * `timed_thumbnails`: Thumbnails intended to be shown at specific timestamps (e.g., preview scrubbing).
  * `non_diegetic`: Audio/subtitle track that is non-diegetic (e.g., background score/music not coming from the “world” in-scene).
  * `captions`: Subtitles intended as captions (often verbatim transcription, possibly without SDH-style additional cues).
  * `descriptions`: Audio descriptions (spoken descriptions of visual content), typically for visually impaired accessibility.
  * `metadata`: Track that is metadata (not part of the main A/V experience).
  * `dependent`: Indicates this stream is dependent on another (e.g., an auxiliary stream that only makes sense alongside a primary stream).
  * `still_image`: Stream is a still image (as opposed to timed video frames).
  * `multilayer`: Indicates the stream participates in a multi-layer representation (e.g., enhancement layers / layered subtitle or similar container semantics).



* * *

  


it might be a bit tricky to embed this additional information into subtitles embedding,  
I know "same language subtitle" was an issue before,  
and other than SDH,  
allowing a user to select a specific role for a a specific subtitle,  
out of a list of subtitles will probably break the automation,  
or be too hard to implement.

I still want to put the information in here,  
feel free to mark it as unuseful/won'tfix etc..

thanks for you for hard work!

# FR: ability to download metadata/comments from a Patreon post with a YouTube embed #11824

FR: ability to download metadata/comments from a Patreon post with a YouTube embed#11824

Copy link

Labels

[site-enhancementFeature request for some website](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22site-enhancement%22)Feature request for some website[triageUntriaged issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22triage%22)Untriaged issue

## Description

[](https://github.com/andlabs)

[andlabs](https://github.com/andlabs)

opened [on Dec 15, 2024](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11824#issue-2740366667)

Issue body actions

### DO NOT REMOVE OR SKIP THE ISSUE TEMPLATE

  * I understand that I will be **blocked** if I _intentionally_ remove or skip any mandatory* field



### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a site-specific feature
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766) and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [guidelines for opening an issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#opening-an-issue)
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

New York, United States

### Example URLs

<https://www.patreon.com/posts/war-and-peace-35-72691033> (confirmed with a friend that an account is not required to access this post; this isn't the post I'm interested in but that one requires joining)

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I want to download the metadata (description, info.json, etc.) and comments from a Patreon post that itself embeds a YouTube video. Normally yt-dlp barrels down to the YouTube video and downloads that instead; I'd like to suppress that redirect and just get the Patreon post information.

I am trying this with `--skip-download` assuming that would not even try to get the video information, but this still tries to get the YouTube video.

I found the similar-sounding [#2044](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/2044) that suggests using `--ies`, but using `--ies patreon,-generic` just results in `ERROR: No suitable extractor found for URL https://youtu.be/...`.

Am I missing something? I've been searching both the manpage and Google for "embed" and "redirect" but can't seem to find anything relevant; most issues about Patreon embeds are about people actually trying to get embeds but it not working.

(I imagine this same issue would affect other website embeds like Vimeo as well.)

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

# [ArchiveOrg] Add support for downloading archived Twitter videos #12533

New issue

Copy link

New issue

Open

[ArchiveOrg] Add support for downloading archived Twitter videos#12533

Copy link

Labels

[site-enhancementFeature request for some website](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22site-enhancement%22)Feature request for some website[triageUntriaged issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22triage%22)Untriaged issue

## Description

[](https://github.com/andlabs)

[andlabs](https://github.com/andlabs)

opened [on Mar 4, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12533#issue-2895023873)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a site-specific feature
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

United States

### Example URLs

<https://web.archive.org/web/20190520184352/https://twitter.com/narpic/status/1127697630363045891>

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Currently the ArchiveOrg extractor only supports downloading videos from the Internet Archive itself and from archived YouTube pages. It would be great if it could also download archived Twitter videos.

I tried extracting the URL from the `<video>` tag in the archived page for the link I shared and it points to a`blob:` URI. I found [this Reddit post](https://old.reddit.com/r/WaybackMachine/comments/x0hp4b/how_to_download_twitter_videos/) that says someone figured it out, but that they deleted their comment in the wake of Reddit's 2024 API changes and archive.org doesn't seem to have that comment saved either. Other Google results show people trying to juggle m3u8 streams found by something called "The Stream Detector" directly, to no avail.

Right now yt-dlp doesn't even try to pass the URLs through the ArchiveOrg extractor, instead going directly to the generic extractor.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Many systems have IPv6 disabled because unlike IPv4 the protocol is superfluous and turning it off is the fastest and most secure way to avoid many problems, not only limited to iptables / networking interfaces, but also emulation layers, multi-protocol tunneled and soft-tunneled setups involving real or virtual machines, per-application networking permissions management / containers / jails, very very weird networking hacks to mitigate bad DSL lines, QoS and disproportionate server duplicate configuration overhead on at-home non-production environments ... amongst other things that can't be _simply_ addressed any other way or with a "just do a second this, just do a second that". It is a dozen "this and that" and then it still breaks things, which is why it is better left off in the first place. Although in theory you could make some ridiculous effort to keep it on.

So please no IPv6 idealism here.

Git build fails because of requiring a 100.00% unnecessary protocol that causes issues if activated.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

## Description

[](https://github.com/cynthia2006)

[cynthia2006](https://github.com/cynthia2006)

opened [on Oct 4, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14542#issue-3483769930)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

During the development of an extractor (in a plugin), I required to use `_download_webpage()` in manner that allows the content to be read from a HTTP 302 response; much as what would happen with `curl` without the `-L` flag.

Unfortunately, it seems that yt-dlp is hardcoded to follow redirects, and there's no feasible method to stop this behaviour. I require this, for otherwise the webpage redirects to its login page.

The most feasible would have been if there was a `allow_redirects` boolean flag akin to Python requests to toggle this behaviour at a per-request or per-extractor level. I'm not sure why it's not already there, but it would have been useful if it was.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

# Fail to resume download after Http error 416 #12994

New issue

Copy link

New issue

Copy link

Open

Open

Fail to resume download after Http error 416#12994

Copy link

Labels

[bugBug that is not site-specific](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22bug%22)Bug that is not site-specific[core:downloaderdownloader related](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22core%3Adownloader%22)downloader related[core:networkingcore networking related](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22core%3Anetworking%22)core networking related

## Description

[](https://github.com/YuriiMaiboroda)

[YuriiMaiboroda](https://github.com/YuriiMaiboroda)

opened [on Apr 23, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12994#issue-3015353889)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

If a 416 response is received when attempting to download a file via `HttpFD`, a second attempt is made to determine the current length of the file:
    
    
                except HTTPError as err:
                    if err.status == 416:
                        # Unable to resume (requested range not satisfiable)
                        try:
                            # Open the connection again without the range header
                            ctx.data = self.ydl.urlopen(
                                Request(url, request_data, headers))

However, if the `headers` object already contains a `Range` value, it will be included in the second request as well. As a result, another 416 error will be returned and the download will fail.

Since `headers` is an instance of `HTTPHeaderDict`, in the following code
    
    
                request = Request(url, request_data, headers)
                has_range = range_start is not None
                if has_range:
                    request.headers['Range'] = f'bytes={int(range_start)}-{int_or_none(range_end) or ""}'

the `Range` header is added not only to the `request` object but also modifies the original `headers` object. This happens because when the `request` is created, it stores the original `headers` object instead of creating a copy:
    
    
        @headers.setter
        def headers(self, new_headers: Mapping):
            """Replaces headers of the request. If not a HTTPHeaderDict, it will be converted to one."""
            if isinstance(new_headers, HTTPHeaderDict):
                self._headers = new_headers
            elif isinstance(new_headers, Mapping):
                self._headers = HTTPHeaderDict(new_headers)
            else:
                raise TypeError('headers must be a mapping')

But even if the setter performed copying, that still wouldn't guarantee the absence of `Range` in `headers`, because this value could have been passed via `info_dict['http_headers']`.

So I suggest, before making the second request, explicitly calling `headers.pop('Range', None)`.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

The following embedded yt_dlp will crash with
    
    
    yt_dlp.networking.exceptions.RequestError: Impersonate target "" is not available. See --list-impersonate-targets for available targets. This request requires browser impersonation, however you may be missing dependencies required to support this target.
    

when executed by `threading` while the "ordinary" execution on `download()` works just fine.
    
    
    #!/usr/bin/env python
    
    import threading
    import yt_dlp
    
    URL="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TsXMe8H6iyc"
    
    def download():
    
            ydl_opts = {
                "ignoreerrors": True,
                "writesubtitles": True,
                "subtitleslangs": ["sv.*"],
                "outtmpl": "/tmp/data/%(uploader)s/%(timestamp)s/S01E%(upload_date)s - %(uploader)s - %(title)s [%(id)s].%(ext)s",
                 "verbose": True,
            }
            with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL(ydl_opts) as ydl:
                info = ydl.extract_info(URL,download=True)
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
            download()
            z = threading.Thread(target=download)
            z.start()

  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

# Add option to use proxy for extractor actions only #12446

New issue

Copy link

New issue

Copy link

Open

Open

Add option to use proxy for extractor actions only#12446

Copy link

Labels

[core:extractorrelated to core extractor handling](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22core%3Aextractor%22)related to core extractor handling[core:networkingcore networking related](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22core%3Anetworking%22)core networking related[enhancementNew feature or request](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22enhancement%22)New feature or request

## Description

[](https://github.com/zhenyahacker)

[zhenyahacker](https://github.com/zhenyahacker)

opened [on Feb 23, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12446#issue-2872823943)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

There is a `--proxy` option to set proxy which should be used within network interactions.

Current behaviour of yt-dlp with this option is to use provided proxy for **all** network interactions - the extractor actions and the media file actions.

Some sites, including Youtube, have restrictions for their APIs only. If you have got your media file URL from site API you may be able to succesfully obtain media file from anywhere around the whole web.

For example, if you live in Norway and you have a New Zealand georestricted Youtube video, you can use NZ-located proxy to `--get-url` to the actual file, copy-paste it to your browser with no proxy set and get redirected to your nearest GGC server to access this file with higher speed than it would be while piping this file from the other end of the world through NZ proxy.

Yeah, I can manually get direct links to needed formats, then manually download them with direct connection a lot faster and then manually merge them all. But why I should do all of this manually when yt-dlp already have all mechanics to do it automatically?

This, obviously, is not restricted to YT only but can relate to any other site.

* * *

I suggest to make an additional boolean option to set if suggested proxy should be used for the actual media file actions, defaulting to True. If set to False, media files should be accessed with direct connection even if `--proxy` is set to some value.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output

# Support wreq as alternative to curl_cffi that works on FreeBSD #16577

New issue

Copy link

New issue

Copy link

Open

Open

Support wreq as alternative to curl_cffi that works on FreeBSD#16577

Copy link

Labels

[core:networkingcore networking related](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22core%3Anetworking%22)core networking related[enhancementNew feature or request](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22enhancement%22)New feature or request[triageUntriaged issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22triage%22)Untriaged issue

## Description

[](https://github.com/dbohdan)

[dbohdan](https://github.com/dbohdan)

opened [on Apr 26, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16577#issue-4330182519)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

One system I use yt-dlp on is a FreeBSD home server. A FreeBSD installation of yt-dlp is less capable than a Linux installation because curl_cffi doesn't support FreeBSD ([open issue](https://github.com/lexiforest/curl_cffi/issues/365)). The [wreq](https://github.com/0x676e67/wreq-python) library for Python is an HTTP client similar to curl_cffi. It can impersonate browsers with customizable TLS, JA3/JA4, and HTTP/2 fingerprints.

wreq is implemented in Rust and is easy to build on FreeBSD. I would like yt-dlp to support wreq as an installation option. This way FreeBSD users will have a curl_cffi-style HTTP client.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output

### Checklist

  * I've read the [**NO AI / NO LLM POLICY**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#no-ai--no-llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated

  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))

## Description

[](https://github.com/yuoter)

[yuoter](https://github.com/yuoter)

opened [on Sep 5, 2024](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10930#issue-2507844830)

Issue body actions

### DO NOT REMOVE OR SKIP THE ISSUE TEMPLATE

  * I understand that I will be **blocked** if I _intentionally_ remove or skip any mandatory* field



### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766) and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [guidelines for opening an issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#opening-an-issue)



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Development release of yt-dlp 2024.9.2.232855.dev0 works locally, but when deployed to cloud it constantly faces IP bans (requires to sign in to verify that it is not a bot). I tried to use Zyte proxies with yt-dlp, but it seems that it fails to utilize them.  
I guess it is problem that it lacks functionality of verification of CA certificates.

Even though it has option "--client-certificate", it did not help. Might be this option is not developed to work with CA certificates?

youtube-transcript-api had the similar issue that it failed to utilize Zyte proxies and it was resolved by this fork where verification of CA certificate was added:  
[jdepoix/youtube-transcript-api#303 (comment)](https://github.com/jdepoix/youtube-transcript-api/issues/303#issuecomment-2274163459)  
[danielsanmartin/youtube-transcript-api@`f6f51d0`](https://github.com/danielsanmartin/youtube-transcript-api/commit/f6f51d007f14fd588a3c95c4c7abb6d36f536e4a)

Could you add option to verify the CA certificates, so that it would be possible to use Zyte proxies for ban handling with the library? I tried a number of ways to use Zyte proxies without verifying zyte-ca.crt, but without the verification of zyte-ca.crt, it does not work and gives an error.

Here is Zyte’s information on their zyte-ca.crt certificate: <https://docs.zyte.com/misc/ca.html>

I am unsure whether this issue is a bug or a feature request, as I do not fully understand what causes it. I used the same Zyte proxy and zyte-ca.crt certificate with the 'requests' library and the mentioned youtube-transcript-api branch, where it worked. However, it fails here for some reason.

How I was trying to utilize Zyte proxy with yt-dlp:

First, I ran the Python code that contained this:
    
    
    zyte_proxy = f"https://{zyte_api_key}:@proxy.zyte.com:8011"
    zyte_certificate_path = "/path/to/zyte-ca.crt"
    
    # yt-dlp options
    ydl_opts = {
        'format': 'm4a/bestaudio/best',  
        'proxy': zyte_proxy,  # Use Zyte proxy
        '--client-certificate': zyte_certificate_path,  # Path to the Zyte certificate
        'nocheckcertificate': False,  # Ensure certificates are verified
        'postprocessors': [{  # Extract audio using ffmpeg
            'key': 'FFmpegExtractAudio',
            'preferredcodec': 'm4a',
        }],
    }
    

I receive in terminal this:  
"

> Unable to connect to proxy. Your proxy appears to only use HTTP and not HTTPS, try changing your proxy URL to be HTTP.

"

Then I update zyte_proxy URL to be HTTP, and run again, and receive in terminal this:  
"

> [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate (_ssl.c:1007)

"

Then I remove options "nocheckcertificate" and "--client-certificate" and run again, and receive this in terminal: "

> Unable to download webpage: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate

"

Then I update zyte_proxy URL to HTTPS and run again, and receive this:  
"

> Unable to connect to proxy. Your proxy appears to only use HTTP and not HTTPS, try changing your proxy URL to be HTTP.

"

Also, when I ran command "yt-dlp -U" in terminal it prints:  
"

> Latest version: nightly@2024.09.02.232855 from yt-dlp/yt-dlp-nightly-builds  
>  yt-dlp is up to date (nightly@2024.09.02.232855 from yt-dlp/yt-dlp-nightly-builds)

"

I also added verbose output of this code:
    
    
    zyte_proxy = f"https://{zyte_api_key}:@proxy.zyte.com:8011"
    zyte_certificate_path = "/path/to/zyte-ca.crt"
    
    # yt-dlp options
    ydl_opts = {
        'format': 'm4a/bestaudio/best',  
        'verbose': True, 
        'proxy': zyte_proxy,  # Use Zyte proxy
        '--client-certificate': zyte_certificate_path,  # Path to the Zyte certificate
        'nocheckcertificate': False,  # Ensure certificates are verified
        'postprocessors': [{  # Extract audio using ffmpeg
            'key': 'FFmpegExtractAudio',
            'preferredcodec': 'm4a',
        }],
    }
    

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

# Problem

At this moment yt-dlp assumes that any socks5 proxy is a socks5h proxy (capable of resolving hostnames).

I am using a socks5 (socks5a) proxy that does not support hostname resolution.

# Use case

I would like yt-dlp to use the system resolver.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

# Please consider using PRIMP instead of curl-impersonate #13115

Please consider using PRIMP instead of curl-impersonate#13115

Copy link

Labels

[core:networkingcore networking related](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22core%3Anetworking%22)core networking related[enhancementNew feature or request](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22enhancement%22)New feature or request

## Description

[](https://github.com/myrslint)

[myrslint](https://github.com/myrslint)

opened [on May 5, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/13115#issue-3041047192)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Hello,

Thanks for making yt-dlp and continuing yt-dl's path with many great improvements. It is a very helpful program.

I would like to ask that, if possible, [PRIMP](https://github.com/deedy5/primp) is used instead of curl-impersonate for browser impersonation.

Based on what I have learnt so far,

  1. development on [the original curl-impersonate](https://github.com/lwthiker/curl-impersonate) has stopped or stalled;
  2. [the fork](https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate) that is still in development and often installed by users is looking to create a [pay-walled "pro" version](https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/issues/102#issuecomment-2736810295) for at least some (mobile?) targets;
  3. PRIMP does **not** (yet?) have feature parity with curl-impersonate.



I cannot offer a pull request or a useful comparison of PRIMP to curl-impersonate, unfortunately, so this remains a wishful feature request up for your consideration.

No output log is provided because this is a request for a feature that does not exist yet. There is not any technical deficiency in curl-impersonate which is currently used, as far as I'm ware.

Reactions are currently unavailable

### Checklist

  * I've read the [**NO AI / NO LLM POLICY**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#no-ai--no-llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

_No response_

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

yt-dlp does not recognize the name of the default subtitle format for vkvideo.ru and requires to manually specify "vtt". The format in question seems to be vtt, just under a different name.

It would be more convenient, if yt-dlp simply saved the subtitles with the nonstandard name. Or replaced the extension with the correct one, when it is possible to determine. Or automatically advanced to the next format in the list, when it cannot save the default one.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output
    
    
    $ yt-dlp https://vkvideo.ru/video-213276384_456243249 --write-subs --skip-download -vU
    [debug] Command-line config: ['https://vkvideo.ru/video-213276384_456243249', '--write-subs', '--skip-download', '-vU']
    [debug] User config "/home/tkzv/yt-dlp.conf": ['--alias', 'tg', '--write-info-json -o "%(channel)s[%(id)s].%(ext)s"', '--alias', 'x', '--proxy socks5h://127.0.0.1:9050', '--alias', 'yt', '--proxy socks5h://127.0.0.1:9250']
    [debug] Encodings: locale UTF-8, fs utf-8, pref UTF-8, out utf-8, error utf-8, screen utf-8

### Checklist

  * I've read the [**NO AI / NO LLM POLICY**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#no-ai--no-llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I'm reporting a new site support request
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

USA

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I am unable to download videos hosted on vids.io that require not only a password but also an email address. The Email is then used in a watermark on the web player (along with IP and a GUID).

Trying to download the video with just the URL will say "This video is password-protected; use the --video-password option".

Trying again with the correct password gives the error "Unable to extract any SproutVideo embed url".

I've tried including the cookie from vids.io as well, and that will act like it is downloading the video, but everything is returning 403 Forbidden. I can see it's including the vemail parameter in the URL when the cookies are included.

I've included debug output with just the password as well as debug output when including the cookies. I've redacted my email from the logs for privacy.

I can provide the video password privately.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

Japan

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

As the title said.  
example video:<https://www.patreon.com/AndressASMR/shop/ticklish-tingles-gentle-giantess-rp-2070737>

The redirected video is still the video by this author on YouTube, but all her other shop-related videos will be redirected to this video.

It's just so weird.
